knobs.label: Change
knobs.placeholder: make it a snowy winter day
knobs.help: Whole-picture changes: season, weather, time of day, mood. It cannot remove or add things.

knobs.label: Quality
knobs.help: Higher works on a larger copy of the photo: finer changes, slower, more memory. The first run at each quality prepares the graphics processor once, which takes a few minutes.

knobs.label: Keep the photo
knobs.help: Higher keeps more of the photo as it was.

knobs.label: Strength
knobs.help: How much of the change the new photo carries.
